channel.title: Office Hours
channel.description: A weekly hour on what actually moved in artificial intelligence — a paper, a release, a deployment that worked or did not — argued through by two people who have to explain it to somebody else on Monday. Less announcement coverage, more: what does this change about how the thing should be taught, built or bought.
